titleSq: Objekt afarist me qira në Aktash, Prishtinë
titleEn: Commercial building for rent in Aktash, Prishtina
descriptionSq: Ofrohet me qira objekt afarist me siperfaqe 3034 m², me lokacion ne Aktash, Prishtine.
Objekti ka infrastrukture te plote, qasje direkte ne rruge dhe eshte i pershtatshem per veprimtari te ndryshme biznesore.

Organizimi i objektit:
Bodrum + Suterine + Perdhes + 5 kate
Objekti ndodhet ne nje zone me qarkullim te mire dhe afer sherbimeve publike dhe private.
descriptionEn: Commercial building for rent with an area of 3034 m², located in Aktash, Prishtina.
The building has full infrastructure, direct road access and is suitable for various business activities.

Layout of the building:
Basement + Semi-basement + Ground floor + 5 floors
The building is located in an area with good traffic flow and close to public and private services.
